LanguageData.RWS_Chart_ZoomStartTip: Start in-game day (leave blank to start from the earliest day).
LanguageData.RWS_Chart_ZoomEndTip: End in-game day (leave blank to end at the latest day).
LanguageData.RWS_Chart_ZoomApplyTip: Zoom the chart to the specified in-game day range.
LanguageData.RWS_Chart_ZoomResetTip: Return the chart to the full recorded range.
LanguageData.RWS_Chart_ZoomStatusEmpty: Zoomed: day {0}–{1} — no recorded readings in this range (full range: day {2}–{3})
LanguageData.RWS_Chart_ZoomInvalid: Enter non-negative day numbers (for example, 10 or 25.5).
LanguageData.RWS_Chart_ZoomEmptyPlot: No recorded readings in this day range.
LanguageData.RWS_Chart_ZoomCompareTooFew: Fewer than two of this colony's readings are in the displayed range.
